name: Kvant
about: Kvant (1987-030A), a crewed vehicle (TsM-e), launched 1987 Mar 31. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (ATT).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1987 Apr 30), held fixed
docked to S16609; it stays docked here until its end of mission (GCAT psatcat TDate), when it burns up; the undocking and deorbit burn are folded into that (a fudge of up to a few days)
GCAT gives the end of mission (psatcat TDate) without an hour

events.why: GCAT gives the end of mission without an hour
